historical_source_roles.qualification: Full body including source tests read only for this exact physical-p16 role; no evaluator, simulation, test or runtime probe was executed and no current revision, historical alias, complete connected trace or independent lens completion is implied.

observations: Historical offline quest evaluation validates bounds for case count, steps, wall time, events and output sizes. It labels public provenance as an offline generator-content projection rather than tactical or live authority, and uses explicit NotMeasured results for unsupported causal quantities. The evaluator was only read, not run.

Public and developer report types are separate; a one-way digest joins them and a high-entropy canary scan rejects two selected private values in public JSON. The code explicitly calls the scan heuristic rather than formal privacy proof; other private producers, story rendering and consumers remain separate obligations.

Replay checks format, decision cap and generator revision/manifest, applies recorded decisions and compares expected outcome. Failure promotion reconstructs decisions from public trace choice IDs with default arguments. An initial concern that this necessarily loses currently valid nonempty arguments requires producer/validator tracing; the report body alone does not establish such an admitted action.

Public metrics use typed choice identity, route and preparation outcomes, and developer counterfactual comparisons join naturally matched public observations to private causes. Denominators, overflow, classification and fabricated/misaligned report inputs need separate contract review. Source tests were read, never executed.
remaining: Trace current evaluator capability argument admission and replay promotion, public/private producers and serialization, failure/termination semantics, limit enforcement timing, metric ownership and actual consumers; reconcile aliases and independently assess every lens without running the evaluator.
